items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Harry James and I, we was pretty close. And when he went to California with his band, he recorded one of my recordings.

ctx.x: Now, I'm going to Texas to play a one night stand. Harry James' parents live, not Fort WORTH. Some other part of Texas, Port Arthur, Texas. Now, he wrote his parents and told them that I was, I told him that I was going there. He had his parents to come out, and they had a nice table there in front to see me play. I met his parents and everything through that.

Harry James and I, we was pretty close. And when he went to California with his band, he recorded one of my recordings. He said "I'm gonna make 'Don't Cry Baby' you did." You know? I said, that's beautiful. But, we was pretty close. All through this time we had fun.
Okay. Now, what about guys like Taft Jordan? How did they fit in?
